# tomswallapi_policy (Resource)

A default zone-to-zone policy (fleet posture). Lower priority is evaluated first.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tomswallapi_policy" "loc_to_net" {
  source   = "loc"
  dest     = "net"
  action   = "accept"
  priority = 10
}

resource "tomswallapi_policy" "default_drop" {
  source   = "all"
  dest     = "all"
  action   = "drop"
  log      = "info"
  priority = 100
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) accept, drop, reject, continue, none, ...
- `dest` (String) Dest zone (or all).
- `source` (String) Source zone (or all).

### Optional

- `log` (String) Log level for matching packets (e.g. info).
- `priority` (Number) Evaluation priority; lower first.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the server-assigned numeric id.
terraform import tomswallapi_policy.loc_to_net 42
```
